messages:
Carla M: opened a PR to update the model catalog with supported variant profiles, limits, and a couple link fixes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/412
Mike H: thanks — what are the high level changes?
Carla M: summary: add 'nnint8' quant profile for zephyrx, clarify sequence-length ceilings for aurora-xl (doc said 65536, runtime enforces 51200 for quantized variants), add explicit runtime fallback note for low-memory scheduling, fix dead link to benchmark CSV, and add two SDK snippets for embeddings vs generate.
Jana L: can you add a concise SDK example for the embeddings case? last time folks accidentally used generate and got unexpected truncation 
Carla M: added snippet in the PR description. snippet1:
```python
# embeddings: prefer truncate=True for long documents in SDK v2.1+
resp = client.embeddings.generate(model="zephyrx-mini", input=["very long document..."], truncate=True)
```
Mike H: tiny nit: in SDK v2.1 we call client.embeddings.create in some older examples — make sure all examples use generate to match the SDK shipped with the console
Carla M: fixed to always use generate, thanks
Simon R: bench-bot shows q4_1 achieves ~2.1x token throughput on a100-40 compared to fp16 on same hardware. bench-bot, paste the run link?
bench-bot: https://bench.redwood.ai/2026/zephyrx-quantized-run
Jana L: we should add an explicit compatibility note: nnint8 requires runtime >= v1.8.0 and CUDA >= 11.8 on dedicated hosts
Carla M: added a "Runtime requirements" section to the model card with exact minimum versions
Mike H: wording: prefer "requires runtime >= v1.8.0" instead of "not supported on older runtimes" — clearer for customers
Carla M: updated phrasing across the card to use "requires"
docs-bot: docs CI (linkcheck + lint) passed :white_check_mark: https://ci.redwood.ai/ci/links/412
Jana L: QA ask — can someone verify the sequence-length numbers in the model card match the runtime config docs (sequence ceiling vs per-batch limit)?
Carla M: verified and adjusted the model card table to show both "max_sequence_per_request" and the runtime "effective_max_sequence" with a short note on quantized variants
Mike H: also moved an example anchor so deep links to the "Benchmarks" section don't break the site reflow
Carla M: rebased and pushed a small fix for anchor IDs
Simon R: I'll do a final content pass in 30m and check the examples render on mobile
Jana L: I'll smoke test the SDK snippets after lunch (running local build of docs-preview)
Carla M: sounds good — anyone object to merge after Simon's pass?
Simon R: LGTM from my side (checked links + mobile rendering)
Jana L: LGTM for snippets and link fixes
Carla M: merging now. :tada:
docs-bot: merged PR #412 and triggered docs preview deploy https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/model-catalog/zephyrx
bench-bot: benchmark summary uploaded to bench dashboard (2026-03-22)
Carla M: preview looks OK, leaving a follow-up to add a generator script for the compat matrix so we don't handauthor these tables in future: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/issues/213
Mike H: filed an infra follow-up on runtime flavor detection for CI checks
Carla M: closing thread — thanks all :heart:
